text:
elaine-peopleops: Heads up — when exporting interviewer scorecards from the ATS this morning the CSV columns for interviewer_id and interviewer_email are misaligned for ~120 rows. Looks like IDs shifted into the timezone column. Example snippet:
```
candidate_id,interviewer_id,interviewer_email,timezone,notes
12345,us-east-1,mike@example.com,PST,Good convo
```
-> interviewer_id should be numeric, not region code. Anyone else seeing this?

aj-recruiter: Yep, spotted it after the 08:12 bulk export. Filed TASK-4721 with the ATS. Temporary workaround: export as JSON via the API (`GET /exports?format=json`) and convert to CSV locally. Worked for our batch.

mike-talentops: Sharing the jq one-liner that fixed our file: `jq -r '.reviews[] | [.candidate_id, .interviewer.id, .interviewer.email, .timezone] | @csv' export.json > fixed_scorecards.csv` Saved us from manual column shuffling.

sam-eng: Sounds like a CSV dialect/encoding change during the nightly export job (maybe the CSVWriter default changed). @eng-recruiting-tooling can you check the ingestion lambda that normalizes vendor exports? Might be a `quoteChar`/`escape` default flip.

taylor-hrops: :warning: We have the interviewer training + calibration session tomorrow at 10:00am. If profile syncs don't match IDs, calendar invites and evaluation access will fail for trainees. This is high priority for us to avoid delaying the workshop.

ats-sync-bot: sync_job/exports/1742123456 failed with exit code 1: 'Unexpected column count' — retry scheduled in 5m.

aj-recruiter: I'll do the JSON->CSV conversion and upload to the calendar inviter today so training isn't blocked. Assigning follow-up to @sam-eng to triage root cause and propose rollback if needed.

sam-eng: On it. I'll pull ingestion logs, compare the last good export (1742030000) and the new exporter job. If it's a config regression I can push a rollback within ~2h. Will update here when I have a patch or plan.

taylor-hrops: Thanks all — please tag me with status updates. If rollback is required we need ~30min lead time before the training to validate invites. :thumbsup:
